name: application-org-chart
title: Org Chart
description: Hierarchical organization chart of avatar-card nodes connected by CSS connector lines, for showing reporting structure across a team or company.
useWhen: Visualizing who reports to whom across a team or company.
Each node needs a person's name, title, and avatar rather than a generic label.
The hierarchy is shallow to moderate in depth — a few levels that fit in a horizontally scrollable card layout.
avoidWhen: The hierarchy represents data or files, not people/roles — use Tree View or File Tree instead.
The structure is very deep or wide (dozens of nodes per level) — a dedicated org-chart library with pan/zoom is more appropriate.
You need drag-to-reorganize editing — this component is a read-only visualization.
responsiveBehavior: The chart scrolls horizontally within its container on narrow viewports rather than shrinking cards or wrapping the hierarchy.
accessibility: The chart wrapper carries role='tree' with an aria-label describing its purpose.
Connector lines are purely decorative (aria-hidden) — the person/title text in each card is what conveys the structure.
Each node's avatar uses initials as a text fallback rather than requiring an image.

variants.title: Org chart
variants.description: Two-level chart: a CEO node connected to three VP nodes, on a light surface.
accessibility: The recursive Branch renderer keeps connector line positioning correct regardless of how many direct reports a node has.

variants.title: Org chart (Dark)
variants.description: The same two-level CEO/VP hierarchy, adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Card border, connector line, and text colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
